title: Tech Note: Resizing Forms
author: Jean-Yves Fock-Hoon, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: SET WINDOW RECT / GET WINDOW RECT commands
SET FORM HORIZONTAL RESIZING / SET FORM VERTICAL RESIZING commands
Form object Move/Grow properties and the 'pusher' system

historical_commentary.text: This note explains a significant behavioral change 4D 2004 introduced to window/form resizing commands (splitting the old, simpler SET WINDOW RECT behavior into a distinct RESIZE FORM WINDOW command plus a non-resizing SET WINDOW RECT, alongside a new object 'pusher' system and per-form horizontal/vertical resizing constraints) versus the 6.8-era behavior. It remains historically interesting as a case study in migrating older 4D databases across a breaking API change, and its core form-resizing concepts (fixed vs. resizable dialogs, min/max size constraints, Move/Grow object properties) are still conceptually present in classic Design Mode forms today, though this is all specific to the pre-Project-Mode, form-based UI system that predates responsive/GUI paradigms introduced with 4D's modern web and Qodly-based UI tooling.
related_updates: 4D's form/window resizing command set (SET WINDOW RECT, RESIZE FORM WINDOW, SET FORM HORIZONTAL/VERTICAL RESIZING) has remained part of classic 4D forms for years since this 2006 migration note, though any given command's exact behavior should be checked against current 4D documentation
This note addresses classic Design Mode form windows; 4D's later Project Mode, Qodly Studio, and web-based UI approaches (2018+) use fundamentally different layout/resizing paradigms
